Cusco · Perú

Folk Art Museum

Small figures with stories of local life

Current ratingsOpening hoursView the place on the map
Nearby places

Explore

Popular art in Cusco includes modelled figures and scenes tied to local festivities and daily life. Look at scale, gesture and costume together: a tiny group of figures can tell a fuller story than the most brightly painted individual piece.

Planning your visit

30–60 min · Allow this time for the visit itself. Add travel, admission queues and any scheduled tour separately.

What to look for

Small figures with stories of local life

Choose a scene containing several figures and look from left to right for changes of dress and gesture. A close photograph needs permission and should not obscure the case for other visitors.

Getting there

Walk from the historic centre to the address below. The last street can be pedestrian-only; give drivers the place name rather than just the district.

Get directions

History and local experience

Craft materials and small gestures can describe an entire celebration. Compare the centre of a scene with a figure at the edge to see how attention is directed.

Walking route

  1. Museo de Arte Popular, centro histórico del Cusco
  2. Find the museum entrance in the centre, check the current display and choose one multi-figure scene.
  3. Move around the case where permitted to identify what each participant is doing.
